name: Trials of Harmony
source:
Trials of Harmony is an experimental visual novel told from a mobile messaging app perspective.

In this dark narrative you'll find yourself imprisoned thousands of feet underground and forced to lead a group of mismatched survivors through a series of life-threatening games.

Who's behind all of these abductions and blood-chilling riddles?
And why make them go through all of this?
Will you be able to choose who lives...
...and who ultimately fails the Trials of Harmony.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155410]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《和谐的考验》是一部从移动消息应用程序角度讲述的实验性视觉小说。

在这个黑暗的叙事中，你会发现自己被囚禁在数千英尺的地下，被迫带领一群不匹配的幸存者经历一系列危及生命的游戏。

谁是所有这些绑架和令人毛骨悚然的谜团的幕后黑手？
为什么要让他们经历这一切？
你能选择谁生活吗…
…以及最终未能通过和谐考验的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155410]Steam[/url]]
